name: Breads
desc: Freshly baked breads and rolls, from everyday sandwich loaves to cornbread and sourdough.

recipes.name: Basic White Bread
recipes.prep: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar. Let sit 5–10 minutes. In a large bowl, combine flour and salt. Add yeast mixture and butter. Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth. Let rise 1 hour until doubled. Punch down, shape into loaf, place in greased pan, let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes.

recipes.name: Cornbread
recipes.prep: Preheat oven to 400°F. In a bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk milk, eggs, and butter. Stir wet into dry until just combined. Pour into greased 8-inch pan. Bake 20–25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Multigrain Rolls
recipes.prep: Dissolve yeast in warm water with honey. In a large bowl, combine flours, oats, seeds, and salt. Add yeast mixture and olive oil, knead until smooth. Let rise 1 hour until doubled. Shape into rolls, place on greased baking sheet, let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Bread
recipes.prep: Dissolve yeast in warm water with brown sugar. Mix in oats, flour, butter, and salt. Knead 8–10 minutes until elastic. Let rise 1 hour until doubled. Shape into loaf, place in greased pan, let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375°F for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.name: Sourdough Bread
recipes.prep: Mix starter and water in a large bowl. Add flour and salt, stir until combined. Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth. Cover and let rise 4–6 hours until doubled. Shape into loaf, place on parchment, let rise 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450°F with Dutch oven inside. Bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 10–15 minutes until crusty.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Sandwich Bread
recipes.prep: Dissolve yeast and honey in warm water. In a bowl, combine flours and salt. Add yeast mixture and olive oil, knead 8–10 minutes. Let rise 1 hour until doubled. Shape into loaf, place in greased pan, let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes.

name: Grains
desc: Hearty grain-based side dishes such as pilafs made with barley, quinoa, and other whole grains.

recipes.name: Barley Pilaf
ingredients: 2 ½ cups vegetable or chicken broth
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onion until translucent. Add barley and stir to coat. Pour in broth, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 30–35 minutes until barley is tender. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.name: Quinoa Pilaf
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant. Add quinoa and stir to coat. Pour in broth, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Dressing: 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp cumin, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Rinse quinoa well. Combine with water or broth in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and cook 15 minutes until all liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and spread on a baking sheet to cool. Combine cooled quinoa with chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion. Whisk dressing ingredients and pour over. Toss well. Stir in parsley and feta if using.

recipes.name: Couscous with Vegetables
ingredients: ½ cup fresh herbs — parsley and mint
recipes.prep: Place couscous in a large bowl. Pour boiling broth over couscous. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and salt. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let steam 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Sauté zucchini, pepper, and garlic in remaining olive oil until tender. Add cherry tomatoes and cook 2 minutes. Combine couscous with vegetables, fresh herbs, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Creamy Polenta
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) water or chicken broth
recipes.prep: Bring water or broth to a boil in a heavy saucepan. Add salt. Gradually whisk in cornmeal in a steady stream to avoid lumps. Reduce heat to low and cook stirring frequently with a wooden spoon until polenta is very thick and pulls away from the sides of the pot — about 30–40 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in butter, Parmesan, and milk until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and white pepper.

recipes.name: Pilaf
ingredients: 1½ cups (300 g) long grain white rice
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until translucent. Add garlic and rice and stir to coat in butter. Cook 2 minutes until rice is lightly toasted. Add chicken broth and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and reduce heat to the lowest setting. Cook 18 minutes without lifting the lid. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Fluff with a fork and stir in fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Polenta
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
recipes.prep: Make polenta by boiling broth and gradually whisking in cornmeal. Cook on low heat 30–40 minutes stirring frequently until thick. Stir in butter, Parmesan, and milk. Season with salt and pepper. Meanwhile sauté mushrooms in butter over high heat until golden. Add garlic and thyme. Season. Serve creamy polenta in bowls topped with sautéed mushrooms.

recipes.name: Farro Salad
ingredients: Dressing: 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, salt and pepper
recipes.prep: Rinse farro. Cook in salted water or broth 25–30 minutes until tender but still chewy. Drain and spread to cool. Whisk dressing ingredients. Toss cooled farro with arugula, cherry tomatoes, and dressing. Top with shaved Parmesan and toasted pine nuts.

recipes.name: Bulgur Wheat Tabbouleh
ingredients: 2 cups flat-leaf parsley, very finely chopped
½ cup fresh mint, finely chopped
¼ cup (60 ml) extra virgin olive oil
recipes.prep: Pour boiling water over bulgur in a bowl. Cover and let stand 20 minutes until all water is absorbed and bulgur is tender. Fluff with a fork. Cool completely. Combine cooled bulgur with parsley, mint, tomatoes, and green onions. Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Toss well. Taste and adjust seasoning. Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving for flavors to develop.

name: Rice
desc: Steamed, fried, baked and simmered rice dishes, risottos and paella.

recipes.name: Yellow Curry Rice
recipes.prep: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Melt butter in a pot over medium heat and toast rice 1–2 minutes. Add curry powder and stir briefly. Add water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 15–18 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Spanish Rice
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Toast rice until lightly golden. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened. Stir in tomato sauce, broth, and spices. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer 18–20 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Fried Rice
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Scramble eggs and set aside. Add vegetables and cook 2–3 minutes. Add rice and stir-fry, breaking clumps. Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil. Add eggs back and toss. Garnish with green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
recipes.prep: Cook rice 70% done and set aside. In a pot heat oil and fry onions until golden. Add chicken, spices, yogurt, and tomatoes. Cook until chicken is done. Layer rice over chicken, cover, and cook on low heat 15–20 minutes. Mix gently before serving.

recipes.name: Jasmine Coconut Rice
recipes.prep: Rinse rice. Combine all ingredients in a pot. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Rice Pilaf
recipes.prep: Melt butter in a pot and sauté onion until soft. Add rice and toast lightly. Add broth and salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 15–18 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.name: Mexican Cilantro Lime Rice
recipes.prep: Cook rice with water, oil, and salt. Once done, let sit 5 minutes. Stir in cilantro and lime juice. Fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Rice
recipes.prep: Melt butter and sauté garlic until fragrant. Add rice and toast lightly. Add broth and salt. Bring to boil, cover, and simmer 15–18 minutes. Rest and fluff.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a pan. Scramble eggs and set aside. Add rice and stir-fry. Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix in eggs and green onions. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Simple Steamed White Rice
recipes.prep: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Add rice, water, and salt to a pot. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat. Simmer 15–18 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes and fluff before serving.

recipes.name: Classic Risotto
ingredients: 5 cups (1.2 L) warm chicken or vegetable broth
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Keep broth warm in a separate pot. Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Cook onion until translucent. Add garlic and rice and stir to coat — toast 2 minutes until rice turns slightly translucent at edges. Add wine and stir until absorbed. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting until each addition is fully absorbed before adding the next — about 18–20 minutes total. Remove from heat and stir in remaining butter and Parmesan vigorously until creamy. Season with salt and white pepper.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
ingredients: 5 cups (1.2 L) warm vegetable or chicken broth
½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
recipes.prep: Sauté mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter and olive oil over high heat until golden. Season with salt and thyme. Remove and set aside. In the same pan heat remaining butter and olive oil over medium heat. Cook onion until soft. Add garlic and rice and toast 2 minutes. Add wine and stir until absorbed. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until each is absorbed — about 18–20 minutes. Stir in mushrooms, Parmesan, and butter. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.prep: Heat vegetable oil in a wok over very high heat. Cook chicken until golden and cooked through. Push to the side. Add eggs and scramble. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir fry 3 minutes until rice is heated through and slightly crispy. Add peas and carrots. Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss everything together. Add green onions. Drizzle with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Saffron Rice
ingredients: 1½ cups (300 g) basmati or long grain rice
½ tsp saffron threads soaked in 3 tbsp warm water
Pistachios and dried cranberries for garnish (optional)
recipes.prep: Soak rice in cold water 30 minutes. Drain. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion until soft. Add rice and stir to coat. Add water, saffron with its soaking liquid, and salt. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and reduce to lowest heat. Cook 18 minutes. Remove from heat and let steam 5 minutes. Fluff and garnish with pistachios and cranberries if desired.

recipes.name: Paella
ingredients: 2 cups (400 g) short grain Spanish rice such as Bomba
½ tsp saffron soaked in ¼ cup warm broth
300 g (10.5 oz) large shrimp, shell on
recipes.prep: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or wide skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken and cook until golden on all sides. Remove. Add chorizo and cook 2 minutes. Add onion, pepper, and garlic and cook until soft. Add tomatoes and paprika and cook 3 minutes. Add rice and stir to coat 2 minutes. Add warm broth and saffron. Return chicken. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook uncovered 15 minutes without stirring. Add shrimp on top and cook 5 more minutes until shrimp are pink and rice has absorbed liquid. Let rest 5 minutes. Garnish with parsley and lemon.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.prep: Heat oil in a wok over very high heat. Add onion and garlic and stir fry 2 minutes. Add eggs and scramble. Add cold rice and break up clumps. Stir fry 3 minutes until heated through and slightly crispy. Add peas, carrots, and corn. Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss everything together. Garnish with green onions.

recipes.name: Mujaddara Lentils and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup (190 g) green or brown lentils
Plain yogurt and fresh mint to serve
recipes.prep: Caramelize onions in olive oil over medium heat for 30–40 minutes stirring occasionally until deep golden and sweet. Remove half the onions. Add lentils and water to the pot. Cook 15 minutes. Add rice, cumin, allspice, salt, and pepper. Cover and cook on low heat 18–20 minutes until rice and lentils are tender. Serve topped with remaining caramelized onions and plain yogurt.
